report.summary: PLAY05 correction1/1 on the reused two-file candidate: (1) the entire unrelated Noor/parcel/greenhouse objectives fragment (all three headings+prose, not just the exp-objectives wrapper) is now absent in the active manual market board, with byte-identical wrapper+contents preserved outside market and in legacy runs; (2) salvage guidance derives current carried market goods from item0/item1 real bag membership+state separately from the historical market.stockTaken consequence flag - after dropping all taken goods it shows a truthful short re-collect/return choice ('货已离包：捡回或撤离') without claiming possession, keeping the day1/2 one-day EUR8->EUR10 surcharge fact and the day3 no-next-day fact; one remaining carried good keeps truthful carried guidance; collect/drop/recollect refresh through the existing signature cache (item0/item1 bag membership added to signature keys), no forced ui.signature reset or production-state overwrite; (3) the existing focus card now renders ahead of generic board exposition in both manual and auto, with all choices/controls/risks and outside/legacy order unchanged. Three focused regressions were appended (original 11 assertions untouched) and were RED on the unchanged candidate for the exact target defects (11 pass / 3 fail: visible child prose, false '货已入包' after drop both once and after both goods dropped), then GREEN after the fix. No GUI, fun or adoption claim; no core/auto/scene/css/economy/saves/routing change.

tests.summary: Final 14/14 pass (11 original + 3 new correction regressions). Earlier against unchanged candidate: 11 pass / 3 fail as expected - objectives child prose visible in market, and focus card falsely claimed goods in bag after drop (once and after both goods dropped).
Final 32/32 pass across both old market shift suites; all pre-existing assertions unchanged.
